implementation.note: implemented_in_code = a dedicated capability handler or tool directory exists; referenced_in_app_code = the entity is used by application source (e.g. repo-pet sprites, CLI) but has no dedicated handler. code_refs are files that reference this entity by name/slug/handler (grep), not a guarantee of a dedicated runtime; registry handler links point at the actual capability function.

proposed.command: mise roster run pickle-doc --dept operations-kitchen --solo --emit report
proposed.contract: inputs: batch start date, salinity / pH readings, culture lineage, target profile → outputs: batch readiness verdict, culture log, shelf-life label; refuses to emit 'ready' unless the proof gate passes

lore: Most of the brigade only notices Pickle Doc when something is missing, which is exactly the point. Pickle Doc manages slow processes (ferments, cures, brines) by tracking time, salinity and cultures until they are proven ready; the image the crew uses for it is a shelf of labelled jars that each tell a story. The card calls out Preservation, Success Rate, Brine Analysis: the checks Pickle Doc runs before calling anything ready. In the canon crosswalk this card is a provisional match for Reserve Rune.

workflow.summary: Pickle Doc manages slow processes (ferments, cures, brines) by tracking time, salinity and cultures until they are proven ready.
workflow.proof_gate: Readiness gate: a batch is released only when pH/salinity readings and elapsed time both meet the recipe; lineage must be recorded.
